title: 3 SPEED AUTO TRANS-TO ENGINE
summary: Automatic transmission (M40 Turbo Hydra-Matic 400) to engine: transmission assembly by engine (350, LS5 454, LS7 454), the fluid dipstick (gage) and its filler tube with seal into the transmission pan, and fill instructions with an oil-level vs. temperature chart. Two bolts through the bellhousing into the engine also hold the dipstick tube bracket and the battery cable clip; the filler tube pushes into the pan with a seal. Fluid 1.187 gal; chassis grease on the propeller shaft (driveshaft) front yoke.

fastening.note: Bolts [2] go through the transmission bellhousing flange into the engine. Upper bolt also passes through the bracket on the dipstick/filler tube; lower bolt also holds the battery cable clip (see UPC 12). Remaining bellhousing bolts not shown.
View A: filler tube [4] pushes into the pan boss with seal [5]; seal lubricated with 2b. Tube held at the top by the bracket under bolt [2].
Dipstick (gage) [1] inserts into the top of the filler tube.

notes: Filling: 1) Add the specified fluid through the filler tube before starting the engine. 2) With the transmission in neutral and throttle on fast idle cam, start the engine and run one minute.
3) With engine idling in neutral, oil level must be within 1/4 inch of the point on the gage given by the chart.
CAUTION: vehicle must not be driven with fluid more than 1 inch above or below "FULL MARK".
